content:
From: Luiz Augusto von Dentz <<address elided>>

commit 1bf4470a3939c678fb822073e9ea77a0560bc6bb upstream.

conn->sk maybe have been unlinked/freed while waiting for sco_conn_lock
so this checks if the conn->sk is still valid by checking if it part of
sco_sk_list.

Reported-by: <address elided>
Tested-by: <address elided>
Closes: https://syzkaller.appspot.com/bug?extid=4c0d0c4cde787116d465
Fixes: ba316be1b6a0 ("Bluetooth: schedule SCO timeouts with delayed_work")
Signed-off-by: Luiz Augusto von Dentz <<address elided>>
Signed-off-by: Xiangyu Chen <<address elided>>
Signed-off-by: He Zhe <<address elided>>
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <<address elided>>
[ Resolved trivial conflicts in net/bluetooth/sco.c, removed
extra reference on sk ]
Signed-off-by: Todd Kjos <<address elided>>
